title: Malicious code in wiwusen (npm)
description: The npm package wiwusen version 2.0.0 contains malicious code that executes arbitrary commands during installation. It runs a prepare lifecycle script that captures the installer's user and group IDs and writes them to hidden files in the installer's home directory. Additionally, it declares a missing bundled dependency, causing npm to fetch and execute additional code from the registry, expanding the attack surface.
